{{incomplete|article|needs=Release date of Mewtwo Returns}} The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the [[List of animated series specials|animated series specials]] in {{pmin|Australia}} and {{pmin|New Zealand}}. DVD releases are for {{wp|DVD region code|DVD Region 4}}. All releases are {{wp|PAL}}, except the DVD release of ''Mewtwo Returns'' which is {{wp|NTSC}}. ==Pokémon Chronicles== {{main|List of English language Pokémon Chronicles home video releases (Region 4)}} ==Dedicated releases== ===''Mewtwo Returns''=== ''[[Mewtwo Returns]]'' was released by {{wp|Warner Bros.}} on home video in Australia on both VHS and DVD. It was released on VHS in Australia with the catalogue number 22141. It was released on DVD in Australia with the catalogue number DVS22142. The DVD includes English, French and Spanish audio, with optional English, French and Spanish closed captioning. The DVD includes the following extras: * ''[[The Uncut Story of Mewtwo's Origin]]'' * "[[Born to Be a Winner]]" * Trailers of the first three Pokémon movies {{MerchGallery |background={{colorschemelight|Johto}} |border={{colorschemedark|Johto}} |image1=Mewtwo Returns VHS.png |size1=x200px |caption1=VHS cover |image2=Mewtwo Returns DVD Region 4.png |size2=x200px |caption2=DVD cover }} ===''Pokémon Origins''=== ''[[Pokémon Origins]]'' was released by {{wp|Beyond Home Entertainment}} on home video in Australia on DVD. It was released on DVD in Australia on April 28, 2014 and in New Zealand on May 21, 2014 with the catalogue number BHE5430. {{MerchGallery |background={{colorschemelight|Kanto}} |border={{colorschemedark|Kanto}} |image1=Pokémon Origins DVD Region 4.png |size1=x200px |caption1=DVD cover }} ==As bonus content== ===Pikachu shorts=== [[Pikachu short]]s are occasionally included in the same release as [[List of English language Pokémon movie home video releases (Region 4)|Pokémon movies]] on VHS and DVD. While this was originally only done for {{wp|Warner Bros.}} relases and some {{wp|Miramax}} releases, Pikachu shorts are also included on the {{wp|Beyond Home Entertainment}} releases Pokémon: Movies 1-3 Gold Edition and Pokémon: Movies 1-3 Collection. {| class="roundtable" style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{colorschemelight|Pika}}; border: 3px solid #{{colorschemedark|Pika}};" !
